translations.web: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
translations.bsb: For resentment kills a fool, and envy slays the simple.
translations.kjv: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
translations.asv: For vexation killeth the foolish man, And jealousy slayeth the silly one.
